title: Property Play: Propy CEO on the blockchain revolution coming for real estate
raw_text:
Property Play: Propy CEO on the blockchain revolution coming for real estate
CNBC Property Play brings you interviews with some of the biggest names in real estate, touching on everything from commercial and residential to finance and the mortgage markets, innovation in the industry and the growing risk to assets and operations from climate change.
CNBC's Diana Olick sits down with Natalia Karayaneva, founder and CEO of Propy, to discuss blockchain applications in real estate and how the company is deploying $100 million toward modernizing the closing process for residential homes.
Watch the full interview, and sign up to receive the weekly Property Play newsletter, straight to your inbox.
